state.build: b1.2 (recommended recipe), Qwen3.8-Flash-Next NVFP4 QAD checkpoint, thinking on, xhigh effort default, card sampling temp 1.0/top_p 0.95/top_k 20

completed.devops_b1.2: 14 realistic DevOps prompts x 3 repeats at c1, max_tokens 16384, graded by real validators (terraform, kubeconform, actionlint, shellcheck+functional test, helm, hadolint, promtool) + rubric; grader validated 14/14 on references, 0/6 on broken inputs. Result: 17/42 clean runs, mean check score 42.5%. Runaway thinking (hit 16384 inside <think>, no answer) 23/42 = 55%, plus 2 truncated answers. Of the 19 runs that produced an answer: 17 clean, 94% of checks passed. Tasks 3/3 clean: k8s deployment fix, k8s OOM diagnosis, NetworkPolicy, Helm values, incident triage. Tasks 0/3 (all runaways): Terraform module, Terraform fix, GHA fix, GHA OIDC, bash script, Dockerfile. Runaways are not repetition loops: the model drafts the answer repeatedly in thinking, re-verifying against the validator the prompt names. An earlier 32k-budget pass also ran away on the first two tasks. Median wall-clock 246 s per prompt (answered runs 160 s).
